Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 201042 Act Number: 42 Enactment Date: 2010-09-26 Act Year: 2010 Short Title: The foreign contribution (regulation) act, 2010 Long Title: An Act to consolidate the law to regulate the acceptance and utilisation of foreign contribution or foreign hospitality by certain individuals or associations or companies and to prohibit acceptance and utilisation of foreign contribution or foreign hospitality for any activities detrimental to the national interest and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto. Department: Home Department Enforcement Date: 01-05-2011 Type: STATE Location: Rajasthan Notification: 1st May, 2011, vide notification No. S.O. 909(E), dated 29th April, 2011, see Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II,
